_comment: Tech tree (#37). Research labs make points; a tech unlocks once its prerequisites are done and you spend its cost. Parts listed under a tech can't be built or refitted in until it's researched; parts no tech lists are open from the start. Placeholder costs: one lab makes 0.1 points per second (6 per minute).

techs.name: Better photovoltaics
techs.description: Solar panels with twice the output.

techs.name: Dense batteries
techs.description: Batteries holding twice the energy.

techs.name: Improved engines
techs.description: Thrusters with twice the thrust.

techs.name: Deep drilling
techs.description: Drills that mine twice as fast.

techs.name: Automation
techs.description: Robot bays: robots that run craft on power alone. Repair drones: mend damage away from a shipyard.

techs.name: Industrial refining
techs.description: Refineries that work twice as fast.

techs.name: Advanced fabrication
techs.description: Fabricators that build twice as fast.

techs.name: Electric propulsion
techs.description: Ion drives: tiny thrust from a lot of power and almost no propellant, for long, patient freight runs.

techs.name: Nuclear physics
techs.description: Fission reactors: 2 MW from fuel rods made of uranium ore. They leave spent fuel, which a slag ejector can throw out.

techs.name: Warp theory
techs.description: Warp gates: the way to other star systems.

techs.name: Superconductors
techs.description: Mk3 parts built with superconductors, refined from exotic ore found only in some other systems.

techs.name: Heavy fabrication
techs.description: Fabricators that build three times as fast as Mk2, for the biggest jobs.

techs.name: Exotic engineering
techs.description: Mk4 parts: five times Mk1, built with superconductors and exotic ore.

techs.name: Fusion power
techs.description: Fusion reactors: 10 MW from deuterium, which isotope separators pull out of water (slowly, on spare power).

techs.name: Ship weapons
techs.description: Autocannons (shells made from metal, on request) and lasers (power only).

techs.name: Armour and missiles
techs.description: Armour plates, missiles that steer, and point defense that shoots them down.

techs.name: Shields
techs.description: Shield generators: a bubble that takes weapon damage before the parts do, for power.

techs.name: Nanotechnology
techs.description: Nanite bays mend their craft and regrow lost parts; nano-assemblers build ships and kits anywhere, slowly.

techs.name: Antimatter
techs.description: Antimatter made from hydrogen with huge power, held in containment that explodes without power, for 100 MW reactors and mighty drives.

techs.name: Orbital engineering
techs.description: Megastructures round planets: orbital rings (storage and power) and space elevators (cargo up and down without fuel).

techs.name: Planetary engineering
techs.description: Mass drivers: anchored on a rocky or icy body, they throw its own rock to move it to a new orbit (Megastructures panel: Move a world).

techs.name: Stellar engineering
techs.description: A solar swarm: collectors round a star that power every station of yours in its system.

techs.name: Orbital docks
techs.description: An orbital shipyard dock: a great frame that builds far faster than any shipyard.

techs.name: Quantum jumps
techs.description: Quantum drives: charge up, then jump to a target anywhere in the same star system.
